findings: Paper maker receipts remain candle-modeled across all 24 observed account pairs.
The existing tick-depth-v1 plan allow-list is a SOL Trend Impulse study, not general maker support.
Fresh reordered prints can be discarded by the monotonic price guard; V2 separates maker matching from mark/trail updates.
59 candle-triggered receipts report zero volume. This is a verification flag, not proof that all 59 fills were fictitious.
ZEC #21176 has fresh crossing prints after placement before its later zero-volume candle fill; BNB/DOGE predate retained tape and M lacks recorded prints in the checked window.

deploymentDecision: Not deployed. Latest exact-depth SOL trade matches net profit with a 48 ms earlier fill. An older partial-fill diagnostic improves, but older arrival coverage is incomplete and a proxy arm misses a profitable trade. No representative all-pair proof of non-degrading net profit exists.
limitations: Universe is the current bot scheduled/observed markets, not all markets Delta could ever list.
Asset classes use the repository fallback taxonomy; live Delta product tags were not imported.
Context sample coverage is not uninterrupted executable tick/depth coverage.
Shadow virtual dollar P&L is intentionally not aggregated or compared with account dollars.
Replay is conditional on accepted orders; it does not establish portfolio opportunity cost for rejected/expired orders.
All entry arms use identical recorded exit opportunities; stream-source switching cannot be claimed as an entry profit gain.
Public data cannot prove exchange queue priority. Missing coverage is unknown, never a zero-loss or unfilled win.
